# Which roles answer a shadow, a lift and a transition?

Read this when your style plugin answers the depth a surface casts, how far a control lifts or presses, or how long and how smooth a change runs.

**The steps live in [`effects.json`](../../../../../contracts/design/effects.json)** for these:

| Roles | Scale |
|---|---|
| `shadow-*` | `shadow` |
| `dur-*`, `ease-*` | `dur`, `ease` |

**Two roles read no scale at all**, and a literal is the only answer for them: `lift-control` and `press-scale`.

<!-- @tree GENERATED by bun run generate:token-tree. Edit that script, not this copy. -->

Your markup and Arena's components both read the roles on this page. A role keeps its name until a major release, and its value is the style plugin's to change in any release.

| role | question | type | user scale | default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--dur-enter-deep` | How long does a dialog, sheet or other surface that commands the screen take to arrive? | duration | none | `{dur.mid}` |
| `--dur-enter-floating` | How long does a menu, tooltip or other surface floating over the page take to arrive? | duration | none | `{dur.fast}` |
| `--dur-hover` | How long does a hover or press response take? | duration | none | none |
| `--dur-state` | How long does a state change the user follows, such as a switch moving, take? | duration | none | none |
| `--ease-enter-deep` | What easing curve does a surface that commands the screen follow as it arrives? | cubicBezier | none | `{ease.emphatic}` |
| `--ease-enter-floating` | What easing curve does a surface floating over the page follow as it arrives? | cubicBezier | none | `{ease.out}` |
| `--ease-hover` | What easing curve does a hover or press response follow? | cubicBezier | none | none |
| `--ease-state` | What easing curve does a state change the user watches, such as a switch moving, use? | cubicBezier | none | none |
| `--lift-control` | How far does a control rise under the pointer? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--press-scale` | What scale does a control shrink to while it is held down? | number | none | none |
| `--shadow-control-raised` | What shadow does a control rise to under the pointer? | shadow | none | none |
| `--shadow-control-rest` | What shadow does a button carry at rest? | shadow | none | none |
| `--shadow-surface-deep` | What shadow does a dialog, sheet or sign-in card carry as it commands the screen? | shadow | none | none |
| `--shadow-surface-floating` | What shadow does a menu, toast or tooltip floating over the page carry at rest? | shadow | none | none |
| `--shadow-surface-rest` | What shadow does a card or panel carry at rest on the page? | shadow | none | none |
